description: This file defines the internal class RemoteGrainDirectory which implements remote access functionality for grain directory management in Orleans runtime. It includes methods for registration, unregistration, lookup, and management of grain addresses, acting as a proxy that interacts with local grain directory components.

classes.name: RemoteGrainDirectory
classes.description: An internal sealed class representing remote grain directory functionality, handling registration, lookup, and management operations for grains across system targets, with logging and partition management.

methods.name: RegisterAsync
methods.description: Registers a grain address with the remote directory, forwarding the request to the local router.

methods.name: RegisterMany
methods.description: Registers multiple grain addresses in batch, validating input and delegating to the router.

methods.name: UnregisterAsync
methods.description: Unregisters a specific grain address from the directory.

methods.name: UnregisterManyAsync
methods.description: Unregisters multiple grain addresses in batch.

methods.name: DeleteGrainAsync
methods.description: Deletes the specified grain from the directory.

methods.name: LookupAsync
methods.description: Performs a lookup for a grain ID to retrieve its address and tag.

methods.name: LookUpMany
methods.description: Performs batch lookups for a list of grain IDs and versions, considering local cache validity.

methods.name: AcceptSplitPartition
methods.description: Handles acceptance of a split partition of activations, delegating to the handoff manager.
